commands.command:
set -e
EXPECTED_SHA="15931fa8341784a308f8a8b9ea6ebd68279241fc"

git fetch origin main --quiet
git checkout --detach "$EXPECTED_SHA" >/dev/null 2>&1
test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "$EXPECTED_SHA"

APK="$(find app/build/outputs/apk/debug -name '*.apk' -type f | head -n1)"
if [ -z "$APK" ]; then
  export JAVA_HOME="$(/usr/libexec/java_home -v 21)"
  ./gradlew --no-daemon :app:assembleDebug
  APK="$(find app/build/outputs/apk/debug -name '*.apk' -type f | head -n1)"
fi
test -n "$APK"

adb kill-server >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
adb start-server >/dev/null
adb devices -l

USB_SERIAL="$(adb devices | awk 'NR>1 && $2=="device" && $1 !~ /:/ {print $1; exit}')"
test -n "$USB_SERIAL"

MODEL="$(adb -s "$USB_SERIAL" shell getprop ro.product.model | tr -d '\r')"
test "$MODEL" = "SM-S906B"
echo "S22_USB_CONNECTED serial=$USB_SERIAL model=$MODEL"

OUT="$(adb -s "$USB_SERIAL" install -r "$APK" 2>&1)"
printf '%s\n' "$OUT"

test -n "$(adb -s "$USB_SERIAL" shell pm path io.blueeye | tr -d '\r' | head -n1)"
adb -s "$USB_SERIAL" shell monkey -p io.blueeye -c android.intent.category.LAUNCHER 1 >/dev/null
sleep 1
PID="$(adb -s "$USB_SERIAL" shell pidof io.blueeye | tr -d '\r' | head -n1)"
test -n "$PID"

printf 'USB_FINAL_INSTALL_OK sha=%s model=SM-S906B package=io.blueeye data_preserved=yes app_running=yes pid=%s\n' "$EXPECTED_SHA" "$PID"
